items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: P-Rod was loafing. He's coming to me and begging me for jobs.

ctx.x: Did you have a trombone in that band? Yes. Any trombone? Yeah.

Yeah. At one time. Before Dr. Louie Warnie was playing trombone with me. Louie Warnie. Then after I gave Doc a break. Nobody wouldn't hire Doc. I gave Doc a break. I put him back to work. Just like Rickard Alexis was down to the breaks. I had all the work around him. I had it. P-Rod was loafing. He's coming to me and begging me for jobs. So Rickard was down. Nobody wouldn't hire him. He was afraid. He'd take a deposit from you. He'd take a deposit from you. He'd take a deposit from you. And all that's on the same…
They said Buddy Petit was that way.
